services.desc: More fishing time for your Miami charter: It only takes six minutes to reach the ocean from our dock and most of the fish we catch are just two miles offshore. Miami's warm Gulf Stream waters produce fish all year round, including Sailfish, Wahoo, Dolphin, Kingfish, Tuna, Amberjack, Barracuda and Sharks. We maintain the cleanest charter boat and supply the finest fishing tackle: The "OLD HAT" is a custom 43ft with Cummins QSM11 engines total of 1300 horsepower which makes it the quickest charter boat in the fleet cutting down the time to the fishing grounds.
